pairs.prompt:
Create TWO full-body game sprites side by side on pure #00FF00, a PAIR of opposite contact poses for a SPRINT cycle. Image1 is the character MODEL, identity/style/proportions only. Image2 is a color-coded POSE GUIDE, joint paths and overlap order only. Orange limbs in the guide mean anatomical RIGHT / near-camera limbs, cyan means LEFT / far limbs. Final limbs must use the MODEL cream/blue/white colors, NOT guide colors. No text or guides in output.
CRITICAL DIFFERENCE: In LEFT sprite (phase1), the NEAR RIGHT THIGH comes from the foreground hip and travels toward RIGHT on the canvas, down to the forward contacting shoe. The FAR LEFT thigh travels toward LEFT and bends back, heel lifted behind. The NEAR RIGHT ARM pumps toward LEFT, behind the torso, palm facing inward.
In RIGHT sprite (phase5), the NEAR RIGHT THIGH comes from the foreground hip and travels toward LEFT on the canvas, bent knee and heel lifted BACK behind the pelvis. The FAR LEFT leg is the one extending toward RIGHT to contact the ground. The NEAR RIGHT ARM comes FORWARD toward RIGHT and visibly passes IN FRONT OF the cream torso. This is a real right/left limb swap, never keep the same foreground leg extended forward in both images. At the hip overlap, the near trailing thigh MUST cover the far thigh's upper root in the RIGHT sprite.
Exact IAmiguinho MODEL: small cream egg torso and SHORT thin cream limbs, BIG cream head, blue-and-cream cap and blue propeller, circular blue headphone with cyan ring, plain dark BLANK glass visor at right edge, blue wristbands, small WHITE FIVE-finger gloves (4 curled fingers and correctly placed thumb), big blue sneakers with WHITE soles. Both view STRICT side profile facing RIGHT like MODEL SIDE. Painted brush shading, thick dark navy outlines, top-left illumination. Same head size, body and limbs, proportions in both poses. Head cap-to-chin =41% of standing height, body from neck to shoe soles48%, propeller11%. Forward torso lean about20 degrees; no elongated legs. Runner fists relaxed; palms face toward body midline; dorsal near glove faces viewer, four curled finger knuckles plus thumb wrapped anatomically. Do not flip a hand independently of its forearm.
Two equal square working cells across a2:1 canvas, ample green margins. No ground, shadow, sand, dust, motion lines, numbers, captions, skeleton, guide colors, extra limbs or facial features. This pair will be cut and normalized into separate final animation frames later.
pairs.camera_prompt: Edit ONLY the camera angle of the two heads in image1 to match the strict RIGHT SIDE PROFILE of image2. The blank glass visor should be a narrower vertical oval at the right edge of the cream head, not a broad front-facing screen. Keep the circular near headphone, cap, propeller, head size, poses, leg overlap, arm overlap, colors and white soles unchanged. The left pose has near leg forward and near arm behind; the right pose has near leg BEHIND and near arm in front of torso. Preserve this difference exactly. No new limbs, no palm inversion, no facial details, no text or guides. Keep the pure #00FF00 background and two sprites with margins.

Create TWO full-body sprites next to each other on a pure solid green #00FF00 canvas, one row of two equal square cells. These will become OPPOSITE contact phases (frame 1 and frame 5) of an easy jogging animation. No text, numbers, guides, shadows or ground. Output wide 2:1.
Input 1 is the only character MODEL for identity, colors, proportions and painted style. Use its third view, strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT. Input 2 is a pose-blocking diagram ONLY: black limbs mean NEAR/right, grey limbs mean FAR/left. Transfer the pose, joint directions and occlusion order, NOT its drawing, colors, labels or circles.
IAmiguinho exactly: big cream round head, blank dark screen vertical at right edge of head, round blue headphone with cyan ring, cream/blue striped cap and blue propeller, tiny cream egg body, thin SHORT cream arms and legs, white five-finger gloves, blue wristbands, blue big sneakers with white soles. Thick navy outline and hand-painted shading from top left. Head 41%, neck-to-feet 48%, propeller 11% of standing height. In each cell cap-to-chin size must equal 30.2% of cell height, standing virtual ground-to-propeller height 73.2%. Keep head size and every segment length identical between both sprites. Upright relaxed jog, arms low, short stride, no sprint.
LEFT SPRITE (frame 1): near RIGHT leg is IN FRONT of the other leg at the hip and extends diagonally forward to the RIGHT, near shoe contacting the invisible ground. Far LEFT leg trails to the LEFT, its upper thigh partly hidden BEHIND the near thigh. Near RIGHT arm swings backward to the LEFT of the torso; far LEFT arm swings gently forward RIGHT.
RIGHT SPRITE (frame 5): SWAP the NEAR/FAR limb assignment. Near RIGHT thigh must be clearly IN FRONT at the hip but now travels BACKWARD to the LEFT, with its lifted near shoe behind. Far LEFT leg extends forward RIGHT to contact the invisible ground, with upper thigh emerging BEHIND the near thigh. Near RIGHT arm now swings FORWARD to the RIGHT, visibly crossing and covering the cream torso; far LEFT arm goes BACKWARD LEFT behind the torso.
The two poses are opposite steps, NOT two variations of the same leg leading. They face right in both cells; do not horizontally mirror the whole character.
Hands: anatomically relaxed half-closed runner hands, palms inward toward body, back of near hand toward camera. Four gently curled fingers plus ONE correctly attached thumb per hand, do not reverse palm or twist wrists. All arms connect naturally; exactly two arms and two legs.
Both contact soles share the same ground baseline at 91.4% of cell height. All art fully within its cell with ample green margin. Use the pose diagram's foreground black limb overlap to make the reversal unambiguous, but paint those limbs cream and shoes blue. Far limbs may be subtly shaded slightly darker, not grey. Visor always completely blank.

Keep every limb, every hand, torso, near/far hip overlap, foot position, scale, color and painted style EXACTLY as now. The left sprite is near/right-leg contact, the right sprite is far/left-leg contact; preserve that visible limb reversal.
